description: The categorySchema validates that color is a non-empty string (v.string()) but does not validate it as a valid hex color code. REQ-CAT-002 states categories have a 'color', and the getDefaultCategories function uses hex color codes. Without validation, any arbitrary string (e.g., 'javascript:alert(1)') could be stored as a color value and later injected into style attributes.
recommendation: Add a v.pipe(v.string(), v.regex(/^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/)) constraint to the color field in categorySchema to enforce valid hex color format.
